The "all-in-one" package of Ace Attorney Trilogy - Evidence Tracker bundles
BepInEx 5.4.23.6 (win_x86), unmodified, so that the mod can be installed in one step.

BepInEx
  https://github.com/BepInEx/BepInEx
  MIT License, see BepInEx-LICENSE.txt

Components shipped inside the BepInEx package:
  UnityDoorstop (winhttp.dll, doorstop_config.ini, .doorstop_version)
    https://github.com/NeighTools/UnityDoorstop
    GNU Lesser General Public License v2.1. The source code is available at the URL above.
  HarmonyX (0Harmony.dll, 0Harmony20.dll, HarmonyXInterop.dll)
    https://github.com/BepInEx/HarmonyX  (MIT License)
  MonoMod (MonoMod.RuntimeDetour.dll, MonoMod.Utils.dll)
    https://github.com/MonoMod/MonoMod  (MIT License)
  Mono.Cecil (Mono.Cecil*.dll)
    https://github.com/jbevain/cecil  (MIT License)

The mod-only package contains none of these files.
